summary.name: The Chromium Projects
summary.one_liner: Documentation and code hub for the open-source Chromium browser and ChromiumOS projects behind Google Chrome and Google ChromeOS, aimed at developers.
use_cases: Learning how the Chromium browser is architected
Contributing code to Chromium or ChromiumOS
Finding Chromium design and testing documentation
summary.what_it_does: The site is the home for the Chromium and ChromiumOS open-source projects, which are the code bases behind Google Chrome and Google ChromeOS. It hosts documentation and source-related material, including design documents, architecture overviews, and testing information for working with the Chromium source code. It also provides the ChromiumOS project goals, latest build access, and guidance on getting involved, submitting code, and filing bugs. The content is intended for developers who want to learn about or contribute to these projects.
notable: Open-source upstream of Google Chrome and Google ChromeOS
Includes design docs, architecture overviews, and testing info
ChromiumOS offers latest build access and contribution guidance
caveats: Site is developer-focused documentation, not an end-user browser download page
Google Chrome and Google ChromeOS are separate products built on these projects
